profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: An experienced engineering professional, skilled in full-stack development and distributed systems. Interests in learning new programming languages and translating paradigms to other languages, data pipelines and stateless services, and Event-Driven Architecture patterns.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: I joined Imperfect Foods to solve interesting business problems and improve my Event-Driven Architecture / Event Sourcing skills by learning from and adding to an existing system. I use F# as my primary programming language. My accomplishments include: .NET Framework to .NET Core and .NET 5  service migrations. Developing a greenfield async message based service that is fault tolerant and does not leak domain specific knowledge into other parts of the system. Leading a logging provider evaluation and migration across the entire system. Providing tech strategy and architectural research as well as interviewing engineers and engineering managers.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description: Leading teams focused on converting batch processes into stream processes. Implementing stream processing and distributed systems utilizing .NET Core and Kafka. Leading an internal group dedicated to determining event-driven architecture patterns.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Worked on a React and Node system used for in-store retail. A microservice architecture with SQL Server, Cassandra, and Elasticsearch persistences.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description: Worked on monolith applications used for internal support. ASP.NET stack with Knockout/Razor UI and a SQL Server persistence.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: I started my career at SafeTec as an entry level developer. I was a project lead for 3 years. I enjoyed learning new technologies, processes, and techniques; all with the purpose of improving what the company utilizes. I benefited from being a Project Lead; teaching and learning from team members, taking ownership of projects, and getting to apply the knowledge that I gained.

positions.title: Lab Assistant
positions.description: Assisted students with questions or problems on programming assignments.
